name: trade-journal
description: A private trading journal for futures day traders that runs free on Cloudflare. Agents and scripts send fills; the journal builds positions, statistics and MAE/MFE.

scripts.build: npm --prefix web ci && npm --prefix web run build

APP_PASSWORD.description: The password for your journal, 12 characters or more. Anyone with it can read and change your trades.

AUTH.description: Leave as "password". Set to "access" to sign in with Cloudflare Access instead (then set ACCESS_TEAM_DOMAIN and ACCESS_AUD).
